title: 5930 Bandera Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at the intersection of Loop 410 and Bandera Road in San Antonio, Texas.

rows.label: Size
rows.text: Approximately 5,220 square feet per BCAD. Land area is 1.436 Acres.

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: B-3, Commercial, City of Leon Valley
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not indicate any floodplain on the site.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: Property appears to have a deeded easement for access and parking onto the neighboring property in the rear. This could provide access out to Loop 410 and Ardisana Ave. if installed.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Most recent (2024) Texas State Highway Department traffic count map indicates 210,486 vehicles per day on Loop 410 south of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: Restaurant, Car Wash, Bank, Bar, Office, Mixed Use, or other commercial uses

comments: Possible covered land play with 4 existing tenants with landlord options to terminate
High traffic counts and strong daytime population

qa_notes: VARIANT (mixed): cover headline is 'PAD SITE OPPORTUNITY' and Comments pitch a 'covered land play' with land-style spec rows, so classified 'land'. But the site is improved: Size gives 'Approximately 5,220 square feet per BCAD' (a building), Comments mention 4 existing tenants, the survey shows two existing buildings, and Prismic category is 'Improved'. A human should confirm which cover chip (Land vs Existing Property) is wanted.
TRANSACTION: the PDF never says 'For Sale' or 'For Lease' (cover reads only 'PAD SITE OPPORTUNITY'; Pricing 'Contact Broker'); set to 'For Sale' by default. Prismic transaction_type is null.

ACREAGE CONTRADICTION: spec Size says 'Land area is 1.436 Acres'; the survey (p7) is titled '1.429 ACRES OF LAND' and its metes-and-bounds close at 'containing 1.429 acres of land, more or less'. Prismic stores no acreage (acres null).
SIZE: '5,220 square feet per BCAD' does not say whether that is the building or the land; Prismic size_label '5,220 SF' treats it as the listing size.

DEMOGRAPHICS LABEL CONFLICT: the spec table labels $56,376 / $56,759 / $62,994 'Average Household Income', but the Demographic Overview page labels the same figures 'Median Household Income'. One of the labels is wrong.

DEMOGRAPHIC OVERVIEW FORMAT: not the usual ESRI table. It is laid out per radius (1 / 3 / 5 Mile Radius blocks, each with Estimated Population, Median Household Income, Median Age, a Housing block and an Education & Employment block), with no date, no site name and no Source line. Pivoted into columns = radii and sections = blocks; the first block has no printed heading, so heading is ''. title/date/source left '' because none are printed.
Spec-table source line reads 'ESRI forecasts for 2025.' (no 2030), unlike the other listings.
CITY: cover and Location say San Antonio, but Zoning says 'City of Leon Valley' and the survey places the tract in the City of Leon Valley, Bexar County.

AERIALS (pp5-6) are titled 'Loop 410 and Bandera Road - Sierra Motors' with the map tool's placeholder subtitle 'Texas, AC +/-' (city and acreage blank). 'Sierra Motors' appears nowhere else in the package.

Prismic: title '5930 Bandera Road' matches; zoning 'B-3, Commercial, City of Leon Valley' matches; total_price 'Contact Broker' matches Pricing. Highlights match comments except case: PDF 'Possible Loop 410 Signage opportunity' vs Prismic 'signage'.
Spec p2 contact line: 'bwilson' is set in a larger font than the rest of the email address (formatting glitch only).
